feeds.title: The Motley Fool Canada
feeds.description: From breaking news about the stock market today, to retirement planning for tomorrow, follow The Motley Fool Canada for investing advice. The Motley Fool Canada's mission is to make the world smarter, happier, and richer. We provide financial solutions for investors of every kind. Our suite of products and services are designed to help people take control of their financial lives.

feeds.title: Stocktrades
feeds.description: Stocktrades.ca was founded in 2016 by investors Daniel Kent and Dylan Callaghan, with the ultimate goal of providing Canadian investors with the best possible tools to increase their investment portfolios. In an industry plagued with misinformation, our main priority is to maintain complete objectivity and bring investors around the world accurate, timely and high quality investment news and information.

feeds.title: Dividend Earner
feeds.description: In 2009, I fired my financial advisor and took control of my investments.Since then, I share my dividend growth investing experience along with my mistakes and learnings. Yes, it's not a perfect journey and other DIY investors can learn from my mistakes.

feeds.title: Stockchase
feeds.description: Stockchase documents the daily stock picks and pans and expert opinions of every single guest on BNN Market Call, Online Investing Forums, and Stockchase Research. Discover a daily summary of experts' opinions on stocks and investment tips.

feeds.title: BCSC InvestRight Blog
feeds.description: The British Columbia Securities Commission (BCSC) is the independent provincial government agency that provides unbiased investing information through its investor education website, InvestRight.org. A key goal of the BCSC is to empower investors to protect their financial interests and become better informed about investment products and services.

feeds.title: Steadyhand Blog
feeds.description: Steadyhand offers a better way to invest. Our funds, investment strategy, and advice are focused on producing higher client returns and a simpler, more human experience.

feeds.title: Investment Talk
feeds.description: I am Susan. Mostly I blog about specific Canadian Stocks, especially ones that pay dividends.

feeds.title: Learn-To-Trade.com
feeds.description: Learn-To-Trade.com's blog is a valuable resource for advice and informative write-ups about stock trading, futures and options trading, forex trading, and more.

feeds.title: Stock Target Advisor
feeds.description: Stock Target Advisor provides the latest market news from a blog about analyst research, stock summary, investment opportunities, market share, and insights.

feeds.title: ValueTrend Blog
feeds.description: The SmartBounce Blog from ValueTrend featuring articles on Technical Analysis, Market Timing, Investor Education, Stock Charts, Stocks, Commodities, Seasonality, Market Cycles. ValueTrend's Wealth Management process is rooted in advanced technical analysis that takes advantage of market shifts.

feeds.title: Hashtag Investing Blog
feeds.description: #1 exclusive community for stock investors. Learn, share, and discuss in real-time to make better stock trading decisions.

feeds.title: Barometer Capital
feeds.description: Barometer Readings, Market Updates as they happen. Our investment process provides both objectivity and transparency, helping to ensure ongoing engagement with our clients and advisor partners. Everyday we assess market risks, and identify market leadership through our top-down methodology.

feeds.title: Sage Investors
feeds.description: I am Aman. I help new and experienced investors who want to be financially secure but feel confused and intimidated by investing world. They either don't know where to begin or they feel they are not making progress with their investments. I teach and engage them on how to make educated investment decisions so that they can achieve financial freedom in their lives with confidence!

feeds.title: The Average Joe
feeds.description: The Average Joe provides a dose of investment related news, trends, and financial concepts in a bite-sized format. We educate our audience with a conversational tone that makes finance easy to digest.

feeds.title: PenderFund Blog
feeds.description: Pender is an independent, employee-owned, value-based investment firm located in Vancouver. Our goal is to create value for our investors by generating superior risk-adjusted returns, while protecting capital and minimizing downside risk.

feeds.title: Tradebots, Inc.
feeds.description: We trade like a bot. We employ technical and fundamental analysis to select and trade stocks.

feeds.title: 5i Research® Blog
feeds.description: Get Research on Stocks, Model Portfolios, Forums, Portfolio Tracking Tools and More.Managing financial portfolios doesn't have to be complex. At 5i Research we ONLY work for our members to provide unmatched, independent investment research for everyone.

feeds.title: Investorfile.com
feeds.description: Gerry shares his 20-years of business experience as an investment banker, an IR consultant, and director of TSX-listed company with his insight on current small cap market news events to followers of Investorfile.com. This helps investors to become more informed about the good, the bad and the sometimes ugly practices in the small cap market that can impact share value.

feeds.title: Denaliguide Summit
feeds.description: I started writing about stock technical analysis in 2007, assisting stockholders in a buy-out fight for a small resource company against Rothchild's of Canada. With the technical knowledge of the potential target price, we were able to develop a fair, competing buyout offer and double the stock holders buyout price from a larger miner.
